title: UpdatePractitionerLocationNetworkRequest
description: Request to update practitioner details at a location for a network

groupId.description: Certify (core) group ID of the group to which the practitioner belongs. Same as certifyGroupId; not the internal tenant group id.

data.description: Location-network specific data for the practitioner. Fields are stored in TenantGroupLocationPractitionerNetwork entity and GroupPractitionerLocation entity. Network-level fields (stored in TenantGroupLocationPractitionerNetwork) include: Dates: effectiveDate (maps to networkPractitionerEffectiveDate), terminationDate; Status: networkPractitionerStatus, panelStatus, networkPractitionerCredentialingStatus; Participation: participationType, contractId, terminationReason; Practitioner Info: practitionerRole (array of { "role": "..." } with optional effectiveDate, terminationDate), acceptingNewPatients (canonical enum: accepting_new_patients, closed, existing_patients_only; legacy boolean and Title Case aliases accepted; unrecognized values return HTTP 400); Contact: appointmentPhone, languageSpoken  (List of Language objects); Schedule: officeHours (List of OfficeHour objects with dayOfWeek, openTime, closeTime); Other: suppressSiteFromDirectory, hasDelegatedAuthority, panelCapacity. Location-level fields (stored in GroupPractitionerLocation) include: admittingPrivileges, telehealthSupport, effectiveDate, terminationDate. Specialties should be provided as an array in 'specialties' or 'specialtyIds' field and will be stored in TenantGroupLocationPractitionerNetworkSpecialty table. Each specialty can include specialtyId, effectiveDate, isPrimary, and other specialty-specific fields.

applyToAllNetworks.description: If true, applies the update to all networks the practitioner is linked to at this location. If false, only updates the specified network.
